analysis: The only change in this PR is a one-line edit to a test helper in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Inference/Engine/EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift. In recordServerStream (about line 313), the switch case `.toolCall, .toolCallDelta` now also matches `.logprobs` and continues. This keeps the switch exhaustive after MLXServerGenerationEvent gained a `.logprobs` case in a dependency or other source file that is not in this batch. The edit is test-only. It adds no production code path, no change to the coordinator/provider WebSocket contract (TB-002), no key or attestation handling, no prefix-cache behavior (T-041), and no data exposure. The rest of the file (KV re-slicing, slot-build refusal telemetry and restore-on-throw tests) is unchanged context and uses scripted stubs, so it has no network, weights or secrets. No threat-model assets, boundaries or mitigations are affected. One question remains for integration: the production path that consumes the new `.logprobs` server event (not in the supplied evidence) should ensure that logprob data on the consumer-visible response path stays within the existing encryption and response-handling contract (T-008). That path cannot be assessed from this test-only change.
